questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. They are diamond-shaped with black symbols or words on a yellow background.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic in the intersection or roadway you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows a pedestrian crossing area. Watch for people crossing your path. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs prepare you for upcoming road conditions. They are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you the road will soon become a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. You may see several chevron signs throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs enforce traffic rules that you must follow. This sign means you cannot park in this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a traffic signal is coming. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a traffic signal is coming up at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a yield sign is coming. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians pass first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal to tell drivers turning left on green that they must wait for oncoming traffic to clear first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that farm machinery may be driving in the area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No turns are allowed on this road.
There are a series of curves ahead.
The road may be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: There are a series of curves ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there are multiple curves coming up on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: This diamond-shaped yellow warning sign tells you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you that a lane is ending. Be ready to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower when conditions are poor, such as bad weather or heavy traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign alerts you that a bridge with narrow lanes is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The highway ahead curves only to the right.
The highway ahead turns sharply to the right.
The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
The highway ahead curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road ahead has curves going right first, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do that action. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: A stop sign requires a full stop. Let all vehicles and pedestrians pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A triangular yield sign means slow down and let other traffic go first. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to pass before you proceed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you of work areas ahead. Slow down and drive carefully through the construction zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of low overhead clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a steep downhill slope ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of railroad tracks that cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or catch on the tracks.
